question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1
solution:
The correct answer is '**frustrating**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the impact or emotion associated with certain experiences or events.
 
• The appropriate adjective should indicate a negative emotional response to a challenging situation.
 
• "**Frustrating**" **(****निराशा जनक****)** fits well as it denotes a feeling of being upset or annoyed, especially because of the inability to change or achieve something, which aligns with the context.
 
• Other options ("**surprising**", "**interesting**", "**exciting**") do not fit the context of describing a negative emotional response.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Surprising (आश्चर्यजनक):** "Surprising" means causing astonishment.
 
• **Interesting (दिलचस्प): **"Interesting" means arousing curiosity or interest.
 
• **Exciting (रोमांचक):** "Exciting" means causing great enthusiasm and eagerness.
